flows: External form.reset and its reset button restore all three controlled state and DOM values
Capture and bubble cancellation preserve edits; later input, state and same-value input win their binding while siblings reset
Sibling bindings reset atomically before a reciprocal expression that would otherwise divide by zero
Pending old resets retire on update and dispose; a new generation uses its own supplied initial values
boundary: Four independent JSDOM consumer flows against exact source-built browser bytes. No Input, Textarea, Radio or full CDN package claim.
